items: Strong customer relationships build trust, repeat visits and word-of-mouth referrals, and keeping loyal customers usually costs far less than winning new ones.
Respond promptly and consistently to feedback on every channel, thanking guests for positive reviews and addressing concerns constructively, so customers can see their voices matter.
Personalized offers, loyalty rewards based on preferences and incentivized surveys make guests feel recognized and give you more reasons to stay in touch.
Protect customer data and communicate openly about what's coming next, because trust underpins every lasting relationship with your guests.
